puntoEncuentro: Departure from Marunouchi North Exit (Tokyo Station) at 9:00 AM
descripcion:
Escape with us from the noise of the megalopolis and step into the city that was the centre of samurai power for more than a century. This morning tour is designed for those who want the essence of Kamakura — to feel the weight of history and understand why this small coastal corner forever changed the fate of Japan.

Itinerary:
We will depart at 9:00 AM from Tokyo Station. We will begin at Hase-dera, the temple of the goddess Kannon. From there, we will make our way to Kotoku-in to come face to face with the Great Buddha, the Daibutsu. We will close the tour at Tsurugaoka Hachiman-gu, the grand Shinto shrine that for centuries served as the spiritual and political heart of the shogunate. By lunchtime, Komachi-dori Street awaits with its stalls, traditional sweets, and small restaurants — the perfect place to end the tour.

Accessibility and Recommendations:
This tour is accessible to everyone as there are no steep slopes or uneven pavements. We recommend wearing comfortable clothing, bringing water to stay hydrated, sun protection, and a hat.
incluye: Spanish-speaking guide throughout the private tour
Historical explanations of the sites visited
Entrance fees to two temples included

titulo: Tokyo, Lights and Shadows (Free Walking Tour)
descripcion:
Experience Tokyo from the inside on this Free Walking Tour through the historic heart of Asakusa. Together we'll explore the most authentic corners of the neighbourhood while uncovering its history, legends, and unique energy.

Itinerary:
We begin at the iconic Senso-ji Temple, Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple. We'll walk the lively Nakamise-dori shopping street with its traditional stalls, visit Asakusa Shrine, and finish at the historic Rokku Broadway, the old popular entertainment district of Tokyo.

Note: This is a Free Walking Tour based on tips. At the end, please contribute whatever you feel the experience was worth.

Discover the historic soul of Tokyo on this 3-hour private tour through Asakusa. An intimate and personalised journey through the most fascinating contrasts of the Japanese capital.

Itinerary:
We'll visit the iconic Senso-ji Temple, the spiritual heart of Asakusa. We'll continue along Nakamise-dori with its artisan shops, Asakusa Shrine, and the legendary Rokku Broadway, where theatres once told the story of a different Tokyo.
incluye: Historical explanations of the sites visited

descripcion:
A full day to discover Tokyo's most iconic neighbourhoods. From the electronic Tokyo of Akihabara to the glamour of Shibuya, through the fashion of Harajuku and the fascinating chaos of Shinjuku.

Itinerary:
We start with a hotel pick-up. We'll visit Akihabara, paradise of technology and otaku culture. We continue to Shibuya and its famous pedestrian crossing, Harajuku and Takeshita Street, and end the day in the endless Shinjuku, travelling by public transport throughout.

Immerse yourself in the world epicentre of otaku culture on this tour through Akihabara. A unique journey designed for fans of anime, manga, and video games.

Itinerary:
We'll explore the most iconic anime and manga stores, from large specialist retailers to small second-hand shops packed with vintage gems. We'll visit the best Japanese arcades, the world of gachapon and retro gaming, and learn about Japanese otaku culture and its impact on contemporary society.
incluye: Explanation of anime, manga, and Japanese otaku culture

descripcion:
Discover the magic of Asakusa after dark. When night falls, the temples and streets take on a mysterious atmosphere deeply evocative of Japan from another era.

Itinerary:
We set off from Asakusa and venture into its illuminated historic streets. We'll visit the majestic Kaminarimon Gate with its imposing red lantern, Senso-ji Temple bathed in night light, and stroll alongside the Sumida River. The combination of traditional architecture and the reflection of lights on the water creates an unforgettable visual experience.

A unique evening experience in the heart of Shinjuku. This tour combines the culture of the Japanese bar with an authentic immersion into the nightlife of one of Tokyo's most vibrant districts.

Itinerary:
We'll venture into Shinjuku's most iconic alleyways to discover the local bar scene that tourists rarely get to know. The tour includes exclusive entry to 3 carefully selected bars, with 1 drink included at each. We'll learn about the culture of nomikai (Japanese group drinking outings) and the neighbourhood izakayas that make Shinjuku an unrivalled nightlife destination.

An immersive experience in the world of Japan's most legendary warriors. A guided and exclusive visit to Tokyo's Samurai Museum, with an impressive collection of authentic traditional armour, swords, and equipment.

Itinerary:
We'll visit the Samurai Museum with entrance included. Our guide will explain the history of bushido — the warrior's code — and the influence of samurai and ninja culture on contemporary Japan. A perfect experience for those passionate about Japanese history.
incluye: Explanation of traditional armour and swords

descripcion:
Learn the secrets of authentic Japanese sushi in this unique gastronomic experience. More than a cooking class, it's an immersion into Japanese culinary philosophy, where precision, respect for ingredients, and presentation are just as important as flavour.

Itinerary:
Cultural introduction to the origins and evolution of sushi in Japan. We'll learn traditional preparation techniques using fresh seasonal Japanese ingredients, and finish with a tasting of the day's creations.

Step into the most authentic kawaii universe in Japan at a Tokyo maid café. A tour that combines a guided visit to the café with a full introduction to otaku culture and Japanese kawaii aesthetics.

Itinerary:
We begin with an introduction to the kawaii world: its history, its icons, and its cultural impact. We continue with a visit to the maid café, entrance included, where we'll enjoy photos, exclusive performances, and the unique atmosphere of this cultural phenomenon that has conquered the world.
incluye: Introduction to the otaku and kawaii world

descripcion:
Discover the most authentic and unknown side of Tokyo's nightlife. An experience for those who want to go beyond tourist spots and live Tokyo like a local.

Itinerary:
We'll explore the hidden alleyways and local bars of Shinjuku that rarely appear in travel guides. We'll discover the authentic atmosphere of Japanese nightlife, visit neighbourhood bars where Tokyoites unwind, and learn the unwritten codes of the Tokyo night.
incluye: Access to hidden alleyways and corners

titulo: Among Izakayas and Lanterns of Ueno
descripcion:
A night experience among izakayas, lanterns, and traditional streets in the most authentic neighbourhoods of Tokyo. A tour that captures the essence of everyday Japanese night life, far from mass tourism.

Itinerary:
We'll explore the bustling Ameyoko Street, one of Tokyo's most famous open-air markets. We'll visit a local izakaya where we'll sample authentic Japanese neighbourhood cuisine, and stroll through traditional streets lit by lanterns, immersed in the city's most authentic nocturnal atmosphere.
incluye: Tour of Ameyoko and traditional streets

descripcion:
Experience pure adrenaline in this exclusive experience inspired by the Fast & Furious franchise, right on the streets of Tokyo. For lovers of sports cars and speed, this is the ultimate experience in Japan.

Itinerary:
A 3-hour drive in an exclusive sports car with a professional driver. We'll venture into the most iconic routes of Japanese car meet culture, discovering the settings that inspired the famous film franchise.
incluye: 3-hour ride in an exclusive sports car

descripcion:
A unique experience at Japan's most famous car meet scene. Visit Daikoku Parking Area, the legendary nocturnal gathering point for Japanese sports car enthusiasts that inspired the creators of the Fast & Furious franchise.

Itinerary:
Private transport to Daikoku PA, the iconic car park where hundreds of modified and unique sports vehicles gather every night. With our Spanish-speaking guide, we'll learn about the history of Japanese car meets, the most iconic models, and Bosozoku culture. Photo session included in an unrivalled setting.

Get up close to Japan's most ancient national sport in this exclusive experience with a professional sumo wrestler. Far more than a spectacle, it's a privileged window into the most hermetic and fascinating world of Japanese sporting culture.

Itinerary:
The experience includes a personal interview with the sumo wrestler, where we'll learn about their life, training, and the traditions of Japan's most ritual sport. We'll finish with a traditional sumo meal (chankonabe), the nutritious stew of the wrestlers' daily diet, with a photo session included.

precio: $175 USD (Base 2 pax) + $35 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover the most traditional and picturesque side of Kyoto on a tour through some of its most iconic neighborhoods and temples.

We will begin with a walk along the tranquil Kamogawa River, one of the city's favorite spots for locals to relax and enjoy Kyoto's unique atmosphere. We will then head to Gion Shirakawa, one of the most beautiful and photogenic areas of the ancient capital. Its cobblestone streets, traditional wooden townhouses, and willow-lined canals preserve the charm of old Japan and embody the essence of the historic geisha district.

Next, we will visit the impressive Chionin Temple, the head temple of one of Japan's most important Buddhist schools. Its imposing main gate and expansive grounds offer an experience of great cultural and spiritual value.

We will continue through Maruyama Park, one of Kyoto's most famous green spaces, known for its tranquil atmosphere and beautiful scenery throughout all seasons.

Finally, we will arrive at the majestic Kiyomizudera Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Japan's most iconic monuments. Its famous wooden terrace offers spectacular views of the city and provides the perfect conclusion to an experience filled with history, culture, and tradition.

An ideal experience for those who wish to discover the classic beauty of Kyoto and immerse themselves in the unique atmosphere of Japan's ancient capital.
incluye: English, Spanish or Portuguese speaking guide

precio: $315 USD (Base 2 pax) + $42 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover three of Kyoto's most iconic and visited landmarks on a tour designed for those who wish to know the essence of Japan's ancient capital. This experience brings together some of the country's most representative monuments, combining history, spirituality, and unforgettable scenery.

We will begin by visiting the stunning Kinkakuji Temple, known as the Golden Pavilion and designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Covered in gold leaf and surrounded by traditional gardens and ponds, it is one of the most recognized symbols of Japan.

We will then continue to the famous Fushimi Inari Taisha Shrine, renowned for its thousands of vermilion torii gates that wind their way up the mountain. This sacred place offers one of Japan's most iconic images and a unique experience steeped in history and tradition.

We will conclude our tour at the majestic Kiyomizudera Temple, also a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its spectacular wooden terrace, built without the use of nails, offers magnificent views of Kyoto and stands as one of the country's most important cultural treasures.

A perfect experience for those visiting Kyoto for the first time who wish to discover some of Japan's most famous, beautiful, and historic places all in one tour.
incluye: English, Spanish or Portuguese speaking guide

titulo: Feel the Energy of Osaka (3 Hours)
precio: $175 USD (Base 2 pax) + $35 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover the vibrant energy of Osaka on a tour that combines modernity, tradition, and some of the city's most emblematic places.

We will begin at Shinsaibashi, one of Osaka's most popular shopping areas, where streets filled with stores, cafés, and urban life showcase the city's most dynamic side.

We will then head to America Mura, the heart of Osaka's youth culture. With its murals, alternative shops, and creative atmosphere, this neighborhood reflects the modern and carefree spirit that defines the city.

Next we will make our way to Dotonbori, Osaka's most famous district, known for its spectacular illuminated signs, lively atmosphere, and its role as a symbol of the city's nightlife and gastronomic scene. Here you can enjoy some of Japan's most iconic views.

Just steps away, we will visit the traditional Hozenji Temple, a small oasis of tranquility that preserves the charm of historic Osaka and offers an interesting contrast with the busy streets nearby.

We will conclude our tour at Kuromon Market, known as "Osaka's Kitchen." This historic market houses a wide variety of fresh produce, local specialties, and some of the most representative flavors of Japanese cuisine.

An ideal experience for those who wish to discover the essence of Osaka through its urban culture, traditions, and renowned gastronomic scene.
incluye: English, Spanish or Portuguese speaking guide

descripcion:
Discover some of Osaka's most iconic landmarks on a tour that combines history, culture, and the unique energy of one of Japan's most vibrant cities.

We will begin by visiting the majestic Osaka Castle, one of the country's most important historical monuments and a symbol of the city. Surrounded by expansive gardens and centuries-old walls, this castle offers a fascinating introduction to the history of feudal Japan.

We will then head to the lively Namba district, the heart of Osaka's entertainment and urban life. Its bustling streets filled with shops and restaurants reflect the dynamic and welcoming character for which the city is known.

Afterward we will explore the fascinating Shinsekai area, a neighborhood steeped in nostalgia that preserves the atmosphere of early-20th-century Osaka. Its colorful signs, traditional streets, and local ambiance offer a different and authentic experience.

The tour also includes the highlights of our Osaka walking tour, allowing us to discover iconic landmarks, historic corners, and some of the city's most representative areas.

An ideal experience for those who wish to discover the essence of Osaka through its history, culture, and unmistakable urban energy.
incluye: English, Spanish or Portuguese speaking guide

titulo: Kobe: A City of Taste and Trade (3 Hours)
precio: $175 USD (Base 2 pax) + $35 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover the unique charm of Kobe, a city where Japanese tradition and international influence come together in an exceptional way.

We will begin our tour in Sannomiya, the heart of the city and the perfect meeting point to explore some of its most iconic places.

Our first stop will be Ikuta Jinja, one of Japan's oldest shrines, with over 1,800 years of history. Surrounded by nature in the very center of the city, this shrine offers a perfect introduction to Kobe's spiritual traditions.

We will then head to the famous Starbucks Kitano Ijinkan, housed in a historic Western-style residence that reflects Kobe's international past. This building, considered one of the most beautiful Starbucks in Japan, allows visitors to appreciate the architecture that characterizes the Kitano district.

We will continue exploring this elegant area until we reach the iconic Weathercock House (Kazamidori no Yakata), one of Kobe's most recognized symbols. Its distinctive architecture and history offer a fascinating glimpse into the era when foreign merchants and diplomats settled in the city.

During the tour we will also pass by Steakland, one of the most popular restaurants for tasting the world-famous Kobe beef, one of Japan's most prestigious culinary specialties.

A perfect experience for those who wish to discover the history, culture, and cosmopolitan atmosphere that have made Kobe one of the most fascinating cities in the country.
incluye: English, Spanish or Portuguese speaking guide

precio: $315 USD (Base 2 pax) + $55 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover the essence of Kobe on a tour that combines history, international architecture, nature, and spectacular sea views.

We will begin in Sannomiya, the heart of the city and the ideal starting point for exploring some of its most iconic landmarks.

Our first stop will be the Ikuta Shrine, one of Japan's oldest shrines, with a history spanning more than 1,800 years. This peaceful space offers a fascinating introduction to Japanese traditions and beliefs.

We will then head to the charming Kitano Ijinkan district, famous for its elegant Western-style residences built by foreign merchants and diplomats during Kobe's international opening. Its history-filled streets and unique architecture reflect the cosmopolitan character that distinguishes the city.

Next we will visit the impressive Nunobiki Falls, a natural gem located a short distance from the city center that offers tranquil scenery and a different kind of experience within the city.

During the tour we will also pass by Steakland, one of the most popular spots for tasting the world-famous Kobe beef, one of Japan's most celebrated culinary specialties.

In the afternoon we will head to the modern Meriken Park, located beside Kobe's port. From here we will enjoy beautiful views of the bay, the open waterfront spaces, and some of the city's most representative landmarks.

We will conclude at the iconic Kobe Port Tower, one of the city's most recognizable monuments and an excellent spot to admire the urban and maritime landscape that have made Kobe one of Japan's most important port cities.

A perfect experience for those who wish to discover the unique combination of history, nature, international culture, and coastal scenery that make Kobe an unforgettable destination.
incluye: English, Spanish or Portuguese speaking guide

precio: $175 USD (Base 2 pax) + $35 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover the beauty and history of one of Japan's most iconic cities on this tour of Himeji.

We will begin at Himeji Station and stroll along the elegant Otemae Street, the main avenue leading to the famous castle, taking in the city views and local atmosphere. Along the way, we will pass by the traditional Yamasa Kamaboko Street, known for its connection to one of the region's most emblematic culinary products.

We will also visit the historic Harima Sosha Shrine, an important place of worship with centuries of history that reflects the deep spiritual tradition of the area.

The highlight of the tour will be the breathtaking Himeji Castle, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and considered the best-preserved feudal castle in Japan. Known as the "White Heron Castle" for its elegant appearance, it is one of the country's most important historic monuments.

We will conclude with a visit to Himeji Shrine, where you can enjoy a peaceful atmosphere and learn more about local traditions and beliefs.

An ideal tour for those who wish to discover the historical essence of Himeji, combining culture, architecture, and Japanese heritage in an unforgettable experience. 🏯✨
incluye: English, Spanish or Portuguese speaking guide

Enjoy a tour that combines two of the most fascinating destinations in the Kansai region.

We will begin by visiting the majestic Himeji Castle, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and considered the best-preserved feudal castle in Japan. Known as the "White Heron Castle," it is a masterpiece of Japanese architecture and one of the country's most impressive historical monuments.

After exploring Himeji, we will travel to Kobe Sannomiya, the heart of a city famous for its cosmopolitan atmosphere and international history. We will stroll through the modern Meriken Park, located beside Kobe's harbor, enjoying beautiful sea views and some of the city's most representative landmarks.

At lunchtime, we will have the opportunity to savor the renowned Kobe beef at Steakland, one of the most popular restaurants for this famous Japanese specialty.

In the afternoon we will explore the charming Kitano district, known for its elegant Western-style residences built by former foreign merchants and diplomats. We will conclude at Motomachi, a vibrant area full of history, local shops, and an atmosphere that reflects the unique blend of Japan and the international influences that have shaped Kobe.

A perfect experience for those who wish to combine historic heritage, coastal scenery, international culture, and one of Japan's most celebrated cuisines all in a single day. 🏯⚓🥩✨

titulo: Nara: The Soul of Japan (3 Hours)
precio: $175 USD (Base 2 pax) + $35 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover Japan's ancient capital on a tour filled with history, culture, and traditions.

We will begin at Kintetsu Nara Station, the ideal starting point for exploring one of the country's most historic cities. We will stroll alongside the tranquil Sarusawa-ike Pond, one of Nara's most representative landscapes, surrounded by history and natural beauty.

We will then head to Kōfuku-ji, one of Japan's most important Buddhist temples, famous for its elegant five-story pagoda, the symbol of the city. We will visit the Nara National Museum to learn more about Japanese art and cultural heritage, before making our way to the spectacular Tōdai-ji Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This impressive complex houses the Great Buddha of Nara, one of the largest bronze statues in the world and one of Japan's most important cultural treasures.

Throughout the tour you will also have the opportunity to enjoy the unique atmosphere of Nara Park, home to the famous deer regarded as sacred messengers in local tradition.

An ideal experience for those who wish to discover the rich historical, spiritual, and cultural wealth of one of Japan's most fascinating cities. 🦌⛩️✨
incluye: English, Spanish or Portuguese speaking guide

titulo: Nara & Uji: The Origins of Matcha (8 Hours)
precio: $315 USD (Base 2 pax) + $42 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover two of Japan's most fascinating cultural destinations on a tour that combines history, spirituality, and traditional gastronomy.

We will begin in Uji, a city famous for producing some of the finest matcha tea in the country. We will visit the stunning Phoenix Pavilion of Byōdō-in, a UNESCO World Heritage Site considered one of the masterpieces of Japanese architecture. We will then stroll along Uji's charming shopping street, lined with specialty matcha shops, traditional sweets, and local products that reflect the rich tea culture of the region.

We will continue to Nara, Japan's first permanent capital. There we will walk alongside the picturesque Sarusawa-ike pond and visit Kōfuku-ji, an important Buddhist temple and UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its historic five-story pagoda.

We will also enjoy a stroll through the famous Nara Park, home to the iconic deer that roam freely among visitors and form part of the city's identity.

The tour will culminate at the majestic Tōdai-ji Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site where the Great Buddha of Nara stands as one of the most impressive and iconic bronze statues in Japan.

A perfect experience for those who wish to discover the cultural essence of Japan through its historic temples, centuries-old traditions, and the authentic flavor of Uji matcha. 🍵🦌⛩️✨
incluye: English, Spanish or Portuguese speaking guide
